defects.title: WC-4 contract path undefined when --output names a file (tdd, init-lite, spec-panel)
defects.quote: where `<output-dir>` is the directory the coordinator passed (`--output` / `--output-dir`)
defects.what_goes_wrong: WC-4 takes the passed --output value as a directory, but tdd and init-lite pass `--output <file>` (and AC-2.2 runs `/sc:tdd ... --output <file>`), so the contract path becomes `<file>/return-contract.yaml`, which cannot be created (verified: 'Not a directory'), and AC-2.2 / 7.2 steps 3-4 have no contract to read.
defects.is_fixed_when: The spec states, for every command whose output flag is file-valued (tdd, init-lite, spec-panel, any other), an exact contract path or a separate directory flag (e.g. --report-dir) that the brief passes, and AC-2.2's tdd example uses it.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting the file-valued commands or AC-2.2 drops required P2 coverage; only defining the contract location fixes it.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 2.3 (line 73), section 3 intro 'Contract means' (line 76), rows init-lite (87), tdd (90), spec-panel (120, 'add --output' conflicts with the real command's file-valued --output and --report-dir, CMD:23,460), AC-2.2 (200), 7.2 steps 3-4.

defects.title: Workflow contract path not known before dispatch; pre-creation STOP has no location
defects.quote: | workflow | `--handoff none` | `.dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/return-contract.yaml` | Fresh package each run | Write the contract for pre-creation STOPs too
defects.what_goes_wrong: Workflow takes no output-directory flag and writes under a command-generated `<id>` (INV-B:272), so the coordinator cannot name the WC-4 path before dispatch, a pre-creation STOP has no directory to write the contract into, and 7.2 step 3 ('report path is the WC-4 contract path') is undefined for a P0 smoke command; research's generated claudedocs path has the same gap.
defects.is_fixed_when: The spec gives workflow (and research) a contract location the coordinator knows before dispatch (an output-directory/id flag the brief passes, or an explicitly named fixed path per outcome), names where a pre-creation STOP writes the contract, and WC-4/7.2 step 3 accept that path.
defects.deletion_note: No: workflow is a ready command and a P0 smoke run; removing it from WC-4 without a stated exemption and alternative report path leaves AC-0.4/AC-1.4 untestable.
defects.present_in_others_hint: WC-4 (62), section 2.3 (73), research row (116), AC-0.4 (194), AC-1.4 (198), 7.2 steps 3-4; parallel-safety of any fixed STOP path vs WC-11 (69).

defects.title: Adversarial contract at <output>/adversarial/ contradicts WC-4's <output-dir>/return-contract.yaml
defects.what_goes_wrong: The brief passes `--output <dir>`, WC-4 and the section 3 intro put the contract at `<dir>/return-contract.yaml`, but the adversarial row fixes it one level deeper, so the path the coordinator computes and the file the worker reports differ and 7.2 step 3 comparison fails.
defects.is_fixed_when: WC-4 and the adversarial row name the same contract path for adversarial (either the row uses `<output>/return-contract.yaml` or WC-4 lists `<output>/adversarial/return-contract.yaml` as the named exception the coordinator uses).
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting the P1 fix leaves the filename unfixed ('filename not fixed'), so the coordinator still cannot locate the contract.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 3 intro line 76 ('Contract means the WC-4 file'), AC-1.4 (198), 7.2 step 3 (182).

defects.title: Commands with no output flag cannot meet WC-4 or AC-1.2's --output <dir>
defects.quote: | P1 | AC-1.2 | 7.2 live check on each P1 command with `--unattended --output <dir>` | all steps pass |
defects.what_goes_wrong: cleanup-audit (fixed `.claude-audit/` dir, row says 'output dir is fixed'), index-repo (brief passes 'none', only 'State the output location') and troubleshoot (no output flag, default timestamped dir) get no coordinator-passed directory, so AC-1.2's `--output <dir>` run and the WC-4 'known before dispatch' contract path cannot be satisfied for them.
defects.is_fixed_when: Each of cleanup-audit, index-repo and troubleshoot either gains a directory flag the brief passes and that WC-4 uses, or has an explicitly stated contract path known before dispatch, and AC-1.2/AC-2.3 invoke them with flags they actually accept.
defects.deletion_note: No: removing these commands from P1/AC-1.2 without stating their report location leaves WC-4 unmet for ready commands; a narrowed AC plus a stated location would be a fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: P1 scope 'output flags for commands that lack one' (159) vs cleanup-audit row (85); index-repo row (86); troubleshoot row (91) and WC-6 (64); AC-2.3 (201).

defects.title: No phase adds the WC-4 contract to tdd, troubleshoot, release-split, init-lite
defects.quote: the worker reports the named file until Phase 1 adds the contract
defects.what_goes_wrong: Line 79 and the P1 scope say P1 adds the contract, but the P1 Commands column lists only analyze..load plus fixes to adversarial, cleanup-audit, index-repo, workflow, and the P2 rows for tdd, troubleshoot, release-split add only gate changes (init-lite 'None'), so an implementer following the column ships these without a contract and AC-2.3's 7.2 step 4 (`yaml.safe_load` of status/command) fails.
defects.is_fixed_when: Every section 3.1 command (including tdd, troubleshoot, release-split, init-lite) has its contract work assigned to a named phase in its row or the phase Commands column, consistent with line 79, or an explicit WC-4 exemption with its alternative report.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting line 79 or the P1 scope sentence leaves WC-4 required with no owner; the phase assignment itself must be stated.
defects.present_in_others_hint: P1 and P2 rows (159-160), section 3.1 rows 87-91, AC-1.1 (195), AC-2.3 (201); load and validate-tests have no contract either (112, 125).

defects.title: AC-0.4 requires 7.2 step 3 contract match before the contract exists
defects.quote: steps 1-3 and 5-7 pass; step 4 uses the command's existing report file, since the contract arrives in P1
defects.what_goes_wrong: Step 3 passes only if the report path is the WC-4 contract path and --outcome matches the contract's status, but in P0 troubleshoot reports REPORT.md and no WC-4 contract exists until P1, so AC-0.4 cannot pass and line 154 blocks P1.
defects.is_fixed_when: AC-0.4 exempts step 3's contract-path and contract-status clauses in P0 (e.g. step 3 uses the command's existing report file and its own status), or the 7.2 check is moved to P1.
defects.deletion_note: Partly: removing the contract clauses from step 3 for P0 only is a fix; deleting AC-0.4 entirely would drop the P0 evidence gate (section 1.4) and is not.
defects.present_in_others_hint: 7.2 step 3 (182), line 154 gating rule, P0 row (158).

defects.title: WC-6 fresh output dir per run conflicts with WC-4 coordinator-passed dir
defects.quote: or, if it has none, writes each run into a fresh output directory so a re-run starts clean
defects.what_goes_wrong: WC-6 makes the command (owner: Command) pick a fresh directory per run, while WC-4 says the contract goes in the directory the coordinator passed and is known before dispatch, so a retry either overwrites the first attempt or writes a contract the coordinator does not know to open.
defects.is_fixed_when: The spec states who creates the fresh directory on a retry (e.g. the coordinator passes a new directory per attempt) so the retry's contract path is known before dispatch and differs from the first attempt's.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting WC-6 removes the safe-re-run requirement that retry workers need (CAPS:116).
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 2.3 brief (73), every 'fresh dir' Resume cell in sections 3.1-3.2.

defects.title: Introduced parent-directory contract rule makes parallel workers share one contract
defects.quote: when `--output` names a file (tdd, init-lite, spec-panel), `<output-dir>` is that file's parent directory [revised WC-4 as quoted by findings; files p12/ab3/runs/b3-r5/aud2/... and p16/ab4/runs/d4-r5/aud{,2}/.../orca-worker-contract-spec.md, not on disk]
defects.what_goes_wrong: In the revised specs (runs b3-r5, d4-r5), sibling --output files (e.g. docs/auth/TDD_LOGIN.md, docs/auth/TDD_SESSION.md) and workflow's pre-creation fallback `.dev/tasks/to-do/return-contract.yaml` map to one shared contract file, contradicting WC-11 'Two workers in one worktree must never write the same file' and letting one worker read the other's status.
defects.is_fixed_when: No two workers can be assigned the same contract path: the file-valued rule names a per-output contract (e.g. `<stem>.return-contract.yaml`) or requires a per-worker directory, and the workflow STOP fallback is not a single shared path.
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting the parent-directory rule reverts to defect c08-d1 unless another per-worker location replaces it.
defects.present_in_others_hint: WC-11 (69), rows init-lite/tdd/spec-panel/workflow, section 2.3; the revised text is unverifiable here because the revised spec files are not on disk (quote taken from findings 211, 378, 379, which agree verbatim).

defects.title: Introduced worker_status field not read by 7.2 step 4's d['status'] assertion
defects.quote: a command whose existing `status` uses other values, "such as workflow's", writes the four-value field as `worker_status`, "which WC-5 and 7.2 read in place of `status` for it" [revised WC-4 per finding 282; file p13/ab1/runs/b1-r6/aud/.../orca-worker-contract-spec.md, not on disk]
defects.what_goes_wrong: In run b1-r6's revised spec, workflow's four-value status moves to `worker_status`, but 7.2 step 4 still asserts `d['status'] in {...}`, which holds workflow's own vocabulary, so the check fails on a correct run.
defects.is_fixed_when: Either no command uses a separate `worker_status` field, or 7.2 steps 3-4 read `worker_status` when present (e.g. `d.get('worker_status', d['status'])`).
defects.deletion_note: Yes: deleting the worker_status carve-out (keeping one `status` field per WC-4) removes the conflict, provided workflow's contract then carries the four-value status.
defects.present_in_others_hint: WC-5 outcome mapping, 7.2 step 3, workflow row; original spec has no `worker_status` (grep count 0), so not present in the original.
